form.label: OpenRouter - Key Governance
form.description: API key inventory and unrecognised key activity.

panel.title: Unrecognised keys (active but not in baseline)
panel.description: Joins analytics traffic to the sanctioned-key baseline lookup by name -- OpenRouter's analytics endpoints identify a key by its human-readable name in api_key_id, never by the roster's hash (verified against live data, see docs/schema-verification.md). A hit here is a key that produced traffic but has no match in openrouter_key_baseline.csv.

search.query: `openrouter_index` sourcetype=openrouter:analytics | stats sum(total_usage_usd) as spend_usd sum(request_count) as requests values(model) as models by api_key_id | lookup openrouter_key_baseline api_key_id OUTPUT name as baseline_name | where isnull(baseline_name) | table api_key_id spend_usd requests models

`openrouter_index` sourcetype=openrouter:keys | stats latest(name) as name latest(label) as label latest(disabled) as disabled latest(created_at) as created latest(limit_usd) as limit_usd latest(limit_remaining_usd) as remaining_usd latest(usage_usd) as usage_usd by hash | sort - usage_usd
`openrouter_index` sourcetype=openrouter:analytics | timechart span=1h sum(total_usage_usd) by api_key_id
